meta.title: Railway Atelier — Model Railway Workshop
meta.description: Hand-built drive conversions, mechanical servicing and DCC setup for collectible locomotives, with attention to every detail.

hero.desc: Here, collectible locomotives get more than a new motor — they get a new character of motion.
hero.quote: “Silence is the element in which great things fashion themselves.” — Maurice Maeterlinck

about.label: About the Workshop
about.title: Precision isn't in the details — it's an attitude
about.tagline: We create the motion these models always deserved.
about.body1: Every model passes through the same pair of hands — from the first inspection to the final test. We don't hand the work off, and we don't rush. If something can be done better, we do it better.
about.body2: For us, this isn't a stream of orders. It's a separate story with every model — its character, its condition, and what it can become after the work is done.

services.label: Services
services.title: What happens to your model
services.note: Every conversion is individual. The scope of work depends on the locomotive's construction, its technical condition, and the motor chosen.

items.title: Full Disassembly & Cleaning
items.desc: The locomotive is fully disassembled. Old grease is removed, mechanical assemblies are cleaned, inspected, and assessed for technical condition. If needed, a list of parts for replacement is drawn up.

items.title: Mechanical Servicing
items.desc: The gearbox is fully disassembled, cleaned, inspected, re-lubricated, and reassembled. Mechanical adjustments and new part installation are carried out as needed.

items.title: Preparing for the New Motor
items.desc: The stock motor is removed. If necessary, the frame or mounts are reworked to fit a modern brushless drive.

items.title: Installing the New Drive
items.desc: The new motor is installed, centered, and secured. After mounting, time is allowed for the adhesive bond to fully cure.

items.title: Final Lubrication & Setup
items.desc: Once assembly is complete, the mechanism receives its final lubrication. The locomotive is run in, and the decoder settings are configured.

items.title: Final Testing
items.desc: Smoothness of motion, minimum speed, running stability, and overall conversion quality are checked before the model is returned to its owner.

process.label: How We Work
process.title: Four steps to a new model

steps.title: Intake
steps.desc: We receive the model, document its initial condition, assess its technical state, and agree on the scope of work required.

steps.title: Disassembly
steps.desc: We carefully disassemble the model, document its construction, and prepare all assemblies for further modernization.

steps.title: Installation
steps.desc: We install the new drive, carry out any necessary mechanical rework, check the electrical connections, and prepare the model for setup.

steps.title: Testing
steps.desc: We run the model in, check the smoothness of motion, perform final setup, and hand the model back to its owner with a 6-month guarantee.

contact.label: Get in Touch
contact.title: Have a model to upgrade?
contact.bodyLine1: Tell us about your model. We'll assess its construction, suggest the best conversion option, and honestly explain which work makes sense for your specific case.
contact.bodyLine2: Based in Ukraine, Railway Atelier primarily serves local collectors and model railway enthusiasts. However, we are also happy to accept models from customers worldwide, excluding Russia. International shipping can be arranged through DHL or Meest, with any applicable custom duties paid by the customer.
contact.quote: After a successful conversion, there's sometimes an urge to do something unexpected — turn off the sound. And simply enjoy how quietly and smoothly the model moves.
